thread:
Alice: Quick post-launch sync. Main ask: decide hotfix vs backlog for the follow-on iteration. My default: any user-visible error or paid-customer regression = hotfix. Small UX polish = next sprint. Thoughts?

Ben: From error logs: two high-severity NPEs in suggestion rendering (session aborts), and a p95 latency regression in embeddings during spikes. NPEs should be hotfix; embeddings might be mitigated with batching tweak.

Dana: UX note 9: the suggestion layout shift may be hurting retention. Short-term fix: guard render when payload missing fields and show compact fallback. Low risk.

Carlos: Infra: we can roll a targeted canary by org or feature flag. Recommend canary path for the NPE patch plus disabling suggestions as fallback. Canary plan example:
```
strategy: org_based
match: org_id in ["ember","northstar"]
percent: 5
```

Evelyn: CS report: Ember and Northstar are the two paying customers seeing session aborts. They asked for ETA. If we do org-based canary we can notify them directly and reduce blast radius.

Ben: Dev estimates: NPE fix + tests 0.75d, canary infra config 0.25d, suggestion-fallback 0.5d. Embeddings batching cap ~1d deeper work (defer to next sprint unless customer impact widens).

Canary Bot: Suggested rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 3h with auto-rollback on any session-abort > 0 or error-rate +0.4% absolute.

QA Bot: CI quick report: 4 failing tests (2 flaky). Will prioritize smoke for NPE and session flows once PRs land. Acceptance criteria for canary: session success >= 99.9% for the two orgs over 2h, p95 latency within +200ms.

Alice: Decision: Wave A (this week) = NPE fixes, org-targeted canary for Ember/Northstar, suggestion fallback. Wave B (next sprint) = embeddings batching cap and perf regression analysis. Owners: Ben (fix + tests), Carlos (canary), Dana (fallback UI), Evelyn (customer comms), QA Bot (post-deploy verification). Target canary start: tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Any blockers?

Dana: :thumbsup:

Ben: PR incoming today, pinging reviewers.

Evelyn: I'll prepare comms and notify CS leads.

Carlos: Will provision canary route and monitor.

QA Bot: Smoke runs queued.
